sections.areaSummary: Analysis for Jhanjhra Area covering 3 selected mines, 14 submitted source records, and 29 total observations between 2026-08-30 and 2026-09-29. The data highlights recurring categories including fencing, ventilation, danger observations, strata support, and water management. High severity observations total 11 across the recorded period.

recurringPatterns.title: Fencing Deficiencies
recurringPatterns.summary: Multiple instances of poor, broken, or deficient fencing noted during inspections, with corrective actions involving replacement sections.

recurringPatterns.title: Ventilation Flow Impairments
recurringPatterns.summary: Observations of sluggish air, reduced air velocity due to damaged brattice cloth, and repeated ventilation issues across mines.

recurringPatterns.title: Strata Support and Roof/Side Conditions
recurringPatterns.summary: Reports of spalling roof coal, minor side slip, and support-related observations requiring hydraulic props and timber cogs.

recurringPatterns.title: Water Seepage and Drainage
recurringPatterns.summary: Moderate roof dripping and floor seepage observed near working faces, managed through drain clearing and auxiliary pumps.

attentionAreas.title: Dangerous Conditions and Accumulations
attentionAreas.summary: High severity observations involving excessive dry coal dust, loose side coal spalling, unusual conveyor roller bearing noise, and gas observations.

attentionAreas.title: Safety Infringements
attentionAreas.summary: Personnel found beyond statutory danger fences without safety lamp checks, resulting in immediate removal from the district.
